cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(MonoGameDX12Msaa LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
if(MSVC)
  file(TO_NATIVE_PATH "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}" source_path)
  file(TO_NATIVE_PATH "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}" build_path)
  add_compile_options(/experimental:deterministic "/pathmap:${source_path}=." "/pathmap:${build_path}=build")
endif()
set(SDL_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_STATIC ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_TEST OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_FORCE_STATIC_VCRT ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(native/monogame/external/sdl2/sdl sdl EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
file(GLOB SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS native/monogame/common/*.cpp native/monogame/sdl/*.cpp native/monogame/directx12/*.cpp native/monogame/xaudio/*.cpp)
add_library(mgruntime SHARED ${SOURCES} MemoriaTextInput.cpp)
target_compile_features(mgruntime PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_link_options(mgruntime PRIVATE /Brepro)
target_compile_definitions(mgruntime PRIVATE DLL_EXPORT MG_SDL2 MG_DIRECTX12 MG_XAUDIO)
target_include_directories(mgruntime PRIVATE native/monogame/include external/stb)
target_link_libraries(mgruntime PRIVATE SDL2-static dxguid dxgi d3d12 winmm imm32 user32 gdi32 advapi32 setupapi ole32 oleaut32 version shell32)

add_executable(memoria_text_input_smoke EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL MemoriaTextInputSmoke.cpp MemoriaTextInput.cpp)
target_compile_features(memoria_text_input_smoke PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_compile_definitions(memoria_text_input_smoke PRIVATE DLL_EXPORT)
target_include_directories(memoria_text_input_smoke PRIVATE native/monogame/include)
target_link_libraries(memoria_text_input_smoke PRIVATE SDL2-static)
